localHeading: University Heights door and opener help
localIntro: University Heights is a distinct east-side city with compact residential streets. We can help when an opener reverses unexpectedly, a door scrapes near the floor, or an older installation no longer feels dependable.
localIssues: We check the door’s manual balance and the photo eyes before replacing opener parts. A smooth-moving door and a working safety reversal are both needed for reliable everyday use.
localAdvice: For an upgrade, we can compare a quieter opener with a door replacement and explain which parts can remain. Measurements are especially useful when garage space is tight.
